headline: Fletcher Free Library renovation contract with ReArch Construction, $558,500 water fund use, $741,500 insurance renewal, and grant acceptances.
summary: The agenda includes a contract with ReArch Construction for preconstruction and bidding services on the Fletcher Free Library renovation, not to exceed $60,435. It also covers using up to $558,500 from the Water Fund 460 balance for initial drinking water system planning projects.
items: Burlington Electric Department property, boiler and machinery insurance renewal for 11/20/2026 through 11/20/2027, premium not to exceed $741,500
General obligation public improvement refunding bonds
Balanced and Restorative Justice grant #03440-29000-27 for $230,450.02, July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
Victims of Crime Act grant #02160-VOCA23-4009608-2027 for $140,164 for FY27
Use of up to $558,500 from Water Fund 460 balance for initial phases of Drinking Water System Strategic Capital Planning Projects
Construction Manager at Risk contract with ReArch Construction for Fletcher Free Library Transformational Renovation Project, not to exceed $60,435, funded by Friends of the Fletcher Free Library
location: Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor

the Fund 460 Drinking Water fund balance to fund a portion Of the Drinking Water

Subject 4.3. Approval Needed For Fletcher Free Library Transformational Renovation 
Project Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) with ReArch Construction  
    
Meeting October 26, 2026 - Board of Finance Meeting - Monday, October 26, 2026, 5:00 PM, 
Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor  
  
Category 4. Deliberative Agenda 
  
  
Department Fletcher Free Library 
  
Type Action 
 
    
Recommended Action to approve and authorize the execution of a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) 
contract and any related documents with ReArch Construction for preconstruction and 
bidding services for the Fletcher Free Library Transformational Renovation Project in an 
amount not to exceed $60,435.00; and to authorize the Library Director, or her 
designee, to execute the contract and related documents, subject to final review and 
approval of the City Attorney’s Office. The contract shall preserve the City’s right to 
discontinue ReArch’s services in accordance with the termination provisions of the final 
agreement if the City determines that ReArch’s performance is unsatisfactory or that 
continuation is not in the City’s best interest. Additionally, to approve and authorize the 
establishment of a project expenditure budget of $60,435.00 to support the costs 
associated with this contract, with funding provided entirely by the Friends of the 
Fletcher Free Library through quarterly payments to the City in accordance with the 
approved Capital Campaign Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)
